'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Joe Phillips LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
